```sql
with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        cast(amount as int) as amount_int,
        cast(amount as int) as amount_int_2
    from transactions
    where is_flagged = true
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when txn_time - lag(txn_time) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time asc, id asc) > interval '14' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from cleaned
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        amount_int,
        amount_int_2,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by merchant order by txn_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from flagged
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.account_id,
        a.amount,
        a.txn_time,
        a.amount_int_2,
        a.session_id,
        b.status,
        b.account_type
    from sessionized a
    left join accounts b
        on a.account_id = b.id
    where b.customer_id is null
),
joined as (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.account_id,
        a.amount,
        a.session_id,
        b.account_type as account_account_type,
        b.balance
    from enriched a
    left join accounts b
        on a.account_id = b.id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
select
    dim.status,
    src.account_account_type,
    count(*) as rows_total,
    min(src.amount) as min_amount
from joined src
inner join accounts dim on src.account_id = dim.id
group by grouping sets ((dim.status, src.account_account_type), (dim.status), ());
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

cleaned = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .withColumn("amount_int", F.col("amount").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("amount_int_2", F.col("amount").cast("int"))
)

flagged = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "amount_int",
        "amount_int_2",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    sessionized
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("a.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("b.customer_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.account_id",
        "a.amount",
        "a.txn_time",
        "a.amount_int_2",
        "a.session_id",
        F.col("b.status"),
        F.col("b.account_type"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("a.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.account_id",
        "a.amount",
        "a.session_id",
        F.col("b.account_type").alias("account_account_type"),
        F.col("b.balance"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("dim"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["status", "account_account_type"], ["status"], []],
        F.col("dim.status").alias("status"),
        F.col("src.account_account_type").alias("account_account_type"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.min(F.col("src.amount")).alias("min_amount"),
    )
)
```

```sql
SELECT i.id, i.last_restock, i.product_id, i.quantity
FROM inventory i
WHERE i.store_id NOT IN (
    SELECT o.store_id
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2023-12-24'
      AND DATEDIFF(o.order_date, i.last_restock) < 7
      AND o.store_id IS NOT NULL
)
  AND i.last_restock <= '2025-01-29'
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_inventory.alias("i")
    .join(
        df_orders.filter(F.col("order_date") >= "2023-12-24").filter(F.col("store_id").isNotNull()).alias("o"),
        (F.col("i.store_id") == F.col("o.store_id"))
        & (F.datediff(F.col("o.order_date"), F.col("i.last_restock")) < 7),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .filter(F.col("i.last_restock") <= "2025-01-29")
    .select(F.col("i.id"), F.col("i.last_restock"), F.col("i.product_id"), F.col("i.quantity"))
)
```

```sql
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM sessions
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT *
    FROM accounts
    WHERE accounts.customer_id = sessions.customer_id
      AND (accounts.opened_date > '2024-02-13' OR accounts.status = 'FROZEN')
      AND accounts.opened_date >= sessions.started_at
      AND status IN ('CLOSED', 'FROZEN')
)
GROUP BY country;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_sessions.alias("sessions")
    .join(
        df_accounts.filter(F.col("status").isin("CLOSED", "FROZEN")).filter((F.col("opened_date") > "2024-02-13") | (F.col("status") == "FROZEN")).alias("accounts"),
        (F.col("accounts.customer_id") == F.col("sessions.customer_id"))
        & (F.col("accounts.opened_date") >= F.col("sessions.started_at")),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .groupBy(F.col("sessions.country"))
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("n"))
)
```

```sql
WITH recent_tracks AS (
    -- Filter tracks
    SELECT
        id,
        artist_id,
        title,
        release_date,
        is_explicit,
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', release_date) AS release_date_quarter,
        CONCAT(title, '#', CAST(id AS STRING)) AS title_ref
    FROM tracks
    WHERE (release_date < DATE '2025-08-02' OR title IS NOT NULL)
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        title,
        is_explicit,
        release_date_quarter,
        title_ref,
        LOWER(TRIM(title)) AS title_clean,
        IF(is_explicit, 'yes', 'no') AS is_explicit_label,
        HOUR(release_date_quarter) AS release_date_quarter_hour
    FROM recent_tracks
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(title), 1, 3) AS title_prefix,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', release_date_quarter) AS release_date_quarter_month
    FROM annotated
),
filtered AS (
    -- Rows with no matching plays
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM plays p
            WHERE p.track_id = s.id
              AND p.is_skipped = TRUE
        )
)
SELECT
    is_explicit,
    is_explicit_label,
    release_date_quarter_hour,
    MAX(release_date_quarter_hour) AS max_release_date_quarter_hour,
    ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN title IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_title_is_not_null,
    ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(title)) AS title_list
FROM filtered
GROUP BY CUBE(is_explicit, is_explicit_label, release_date_quarter_hour)
ORDER BY is_explicit NULLS LAST, is_explicit_label NULLS LAST, release_date_quarter_hour NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

recent_tracks = (
    df_tracks
    .filter((F.col("release_date") < F.lit("2025-08-02").cast("date")) | (F.col("title").isNotNull()))
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "title",
        "release_date",
        "is_explicit",
        F.date_trunc("quarter", F.col("release_date")).alias("release_date_quarter"),
        F.concat(F.col("title"), F.lit("#"), F.col("id").cast("string")).alias("title_ref"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    recent_tracks
    .select(
        "id",
        "title",
        "is_explicit",
        "release_date_quarter",
        "title_ref",
        F.lower(F.trim(F.col("title"))).alias("title_clean"),
        F.when(F.col("is_explicit"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("is_explicit_label"),
        F.hour(F.col("release_date_quarter")).alias("release_date_quarter_hour"),
    )
)

scored = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("title")), 1, 3).alias("title_prefix"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("release_date_quarter")).alias("release_date_quarter_month"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored.alias("s")
    .join(df_plays.alias("p"), (F.col("p.track_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("p.is_skipped")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    filtered
    .cube("is_explicit", "is_explicit_label", "release_date_quarter_hour")
    .agg(
        F.max("release_date_quarter_hour").alias("max_release_date_quarter_hour"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("title").isNotNull(), 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_title_is_not_null"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("title")).alias("title_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("is_explicit").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("is_explicit_label").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("release_date_quarter_hour").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        k,
        v
    from carts
    lateral view outer explode(attributes) li as k, v
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        sort_array(coupon_codes) as sorted_coupon_codes,
        coalesce(k, 'N/A') as resolved_k
    from lines
    where size(coupon_codes) >= 2
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        a.*,
        p.signup_date,
        p.country,
        p.email
    from base a
    inner join customers p
        on a.customer_id = p.id
),
enriched_carts as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        s.customer_id,
        s.created_at,
        s.k,
        s.sorted_coupon_codes,
        s.resolved_k,
        s.country,
        b.segment,
        b.name,
        b.email as customer_email
    from enriched s
    left join customers b
        on s.customer_id = b.id
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.customer_id,
        src.created_at,
        src.k,
        src.country,
        src.segment,
        src.name,
        b.email,
        b.credit_limit,
        b.city
    from enriched_carts src
    left join customers b
        on src.customer_id = b.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    country,
    min(created_at) as first_created_at,
    count(distinct country) as distinct_countries
from joined
group by country
order by distinct_countries nulls last;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

lines = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode_outer("attributes").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

base = (
    lines
    .filter(F.size("coupon_codes") >= 2)
    .withColumn("sorted_coupon_codes", F.sort_array("coupon_codes"))
    .withColumn("resolved_k", F.coalesce("k", F.lit("N/A")))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.signup_date"), F.col("p.country"), F.col("p.email"))
)

enriched_carts = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.created_at",
        "s.k",
        "s.sorted_coupon_codes",
        "s.resolved_k",
        "s.country",
        F.col("b.segment"),
        F.col("b.name"),
        F.col("b.email").alias("customer_email"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched_carts
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.customer_id",
        "src.created_at",
        "src.k",
        "src.country",
        "src.segment",
        "src.name",
        F.col("b.email"),
        F.col("b.credit_limit"),
        F.col("b.city"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.min("created_at").alias("first_created_at"),
        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_countries").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
    FROM sessionized

    event_count,
    duration_min,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("course_id") <= 5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.when(F.col("term").isin("2025T1", "2025T2"), "group_a").when(F.col("term") == "2024T1", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("term_group"),
        F.when(F.col("score") >= 57.6, "HIGH").when(F.col("score") >= 11.3, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("score_tier"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    prepared
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status")).alias("grade_status_max_score"),
        F.round(F.col("score") / F.nullif(F.sum("score").over(Window.partitionBy("grade_status")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("score_share_of_grade_status"),
    )
)

course_id_stats = (
    windowed
    .groupBy("course_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("grade_status_max_score", 0.5).alias("median_grade_status_max_score"))

    .filter(F.col("s.grade_status_max_score") >= F.col("g.median_grade_status_max_score"))
    .select(

        "g.median_grade_status_max_score",
        F.round(F.col("s.grade_status_max_score") - F.col("g.median_grade_status_max_score"), 2).alias("grade_status_max_score_minus_median"),
    )
)

screened = (
    above_average
    .crossJoin(above_average.agg(F.avg("score_share_of_grade_status").alias("overall_avg_score_share_of_grade_status")))
    .filter(F.col("score_share_of_grade_status") > F.col("overall_avg_score_share_of_grade_status"))
    .drop("overall_avg_score_share_of_grade_status")
)

tagged = (

        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        "term_group",
        "score_tier",
        "grade_status_max_score",
        "score_share_of_grade_status",
        "median_grade_status_max_score",
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("enrolled_at")).alias("enrolled_at_month"),

        "term_group",
        "score_tier",
```

```sql
        ROUND(closed_at_dayofweek - AVG(closed_at_dayofweek) OVER w_agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek, 2) AS closed_at_dayofweek_vs_agent_id_closed_at_dayofw
    FROM scoped
    WINDOW w_agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek AS (PARTITION BY agent_id, closed_at_dayofweek)
),
with_parent_agent AS (
    -- Join support_agents
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.requester_id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.priority,
        s.channel,
        s.tags,
        s.priority_channel_label,
        s.closed_at_dayofweek,
        s.agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id,
        s.second_closed_at_dayofweek,
        s.first_opened_at,
        su.agent_name,
        su.team AS agent_team,
        su.tier AS agent_tier
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
    WHERE su.team NOT IN ('Tech', 'Billing')
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        requester_id - closed_at_dayofweek AS requester_id_minus_closed_at_dayofweek,
        ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(tags), ',') AS tags_text
    FROM with_parent_agent
    WHERE channel <> 'phone'
)

    closed_at_dayofweek,
    agent_id,

    GROUPING(closed_at_dayofweek) AS is_total_closed_at_dayofweek,
    SUM(agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id) FILTER (WHERE agent_tier IN ('T1', 'T3')) AS agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id_ag
FROM annotated
GROUP BY CUBE(closed_at_dayofweek, agent_id, agent_tier)
ORDER BY closed_at_dayofweek NULLS LAST, agent_id NULLS LAST, agent_tier NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_tickets
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "tags",
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("priority"), F.col("channel")).alias("priority_channel_label"),
        F.least(F.col("requester_id"), F.col("csat")).alias("least_requester_id_csat"),
        F.dayofweek(F.col("closed_at")).alias("closed_at_dayofweek"),
    )
)

w_agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek = Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "closed_at_dayofweek")
ranked = (
    scoped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("requester_id").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "closed_at_dayofweek")).alias("agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id"),
        F.nth_value("closed_at_dayofweek", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("closed_at_dayofweek", F.to_date("opened_at")).orderBy(F.col("closed_at_dayofweek").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_closed_at_dayofweek"),
        F.first("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("closed_at_dayofweek", F.to_date("opened_at")).orderBy(F.col("closed_at_dayofweek").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_opened_at"),
        F.round(F.col("closed_at_dayofweek") - F.avg("closed_at_dayofweek").over(w_agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek), 2).alias("closed_at_dayofweek_vs_agent_id_closed_at_dayofw"),
    )
)

with_parent_agent = (
    ranked.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("su.team").isin("Tech", "Billing"))
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.requester_id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.priority",
        "s.channel",
        "s.tags",
        "s.priority_channel_label",
        "s.closed_at_dayofweek",
        "s.agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id",
        "s.second_closed_at_dayofweek",
        "s.first_opened_at",
        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.team").alias("agent_team"),
        F.col("su.tier").alias("agent_tier"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    with_parent_agent
    .filter(F.col("channel") != "phone")
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("requester_id") - F.col("closed_at_dayofweek")).alias("requester_id_minus_closed_at_dayofweek"),
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.col("tags")), ",").alias("tags_text"),
    )
)

result = (
    annotated
    .cube("closed_at_dayofweek", "agent_id", "agent_tier")
    .agg(
        F.grouping("closed_at_dayofweek").alias("is_total_closed_at_dayofweek"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("agent_tier").isin("T1", "T3"), F.col("agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id"))).alias("agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id_ag"),
    )
    .select(
        "closed_at_dayofweek",
        "agent_id",
        F.coalesce(F.col("agent_tier"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("agent_tier"),
        "is_total_closed_at_dayofweek",
        "agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id_ag",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("closed_at_dayofweek").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("agent_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("agent_tier").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

latest = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure").asc_nulls_first(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity",
        "status_bits",
        "is_new_session",
        F.lead("session_no", 2, 0).over(Window.orderBy("reading_ts", "id")).alias("next_session_no"),

)

result = (
```

```sql
    FROM ticket_events
```

```sql
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM recent_events

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY actor ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
actor_stats AS (
    -- Max new_session_flag per actor
    SELECT actor, MAX(new_session_flag) AS max_new_session_flag
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY actor
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_new_session_flag,
        ROUND(s.new_session_flag - g.max_new_session_flag, 2) AS new_session_flag_minus_max
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN actor_stats g ON g.actor = s.actor
    WHERE s.new_session_flag = g.max_new_session_flag
)
SELECT
    id,
    ticket_id,
    actor,
    actor_or_unknown,
    prev_event_at,
    new_session_flag,
    session_no,
    max_new_session_flag,

FROM compared
ORDER BY actor DESC, id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
        F.coalesce(F.col("actor"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("actor_or_unknown"),
    )
)
```

```sql
FROM (
```

```sql
    FROM with_windows
) src
UNPIVOT (
```

```sql
WITH scoped_events AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        event_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AS event_at_plus_30m
    FROM ticket_events
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per event_type
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM scoped_events
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        event_type,
        session_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY event_type, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    event_type,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
ORDER BY event_type NULLS LAST, session_id
LIMIT 10
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        (F.col("event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("event_at_plus_30m"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_events.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("event_type", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "event_type",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_type").asc_nulls_last(), "session_id")
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id) AS event_count,
        (SELECT MAX(t.event_at) FROM ticket_events t WHERE t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id) AS last_event_at
    FROM enriched s
),
ticket_id_stats AS (
    -- Median event_count per ticket_id
    SELECT ticket_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(event_count, 0.5) AS median_event_count
    FROM summarized_rows
    GROUP BY ticket_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_event_count,
        ROUND(s.event_count - g.median_event_count, 2) AS event_count_minus_median
    FROM summarized_rows s
    JOIN ticket_id_stats g ON g.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
    WHERE s.event_count >= g.median_event_count
),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.ticket_id,
        s.actor,
        s.event_type_actor_label,
        s.event_actor_count,

        t.event_at AS event_event_at,
        t.actor AS event_actor
    FROM above_average s
    LEFT JOIN ticket_events t ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
),
qualified AS (
```

```python
    df_ticket_events
    .filter((F.month(F.col("event_at")).isin(1, 3)) | (F.col("event_type") != "reopened"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("actor"), F.col("event_type")).alias("actor_event_type_label"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("event_at")).alias("days_since_event_at"),
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("event_type"), F.col("actor")).alias("event_type_actor_label"),
    )
)

event_stats = (
    df_ticket_events
    .groupBy("ticket_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("actor").isin("system", "customer"), 1)).alias("event_actor_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("last_event_at"),

ticket_id_stats = (

    .groupBy("ticket_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("event_count", 0.5).alias("median_event_count"))
)

above_average = (

    .join(ticket_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.ticket_id") == F.col("s.ticket_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.event_count") >= F.col("g.median_event_count"))
    .select(

        "g.median_event_count",
        F.round(F.col("s.event_count") - F.col("g.median_event_count"), 2).alias("event_count_minus_median"),
    )

exploded_detail = (

    .orderBy("event_actor", "event_actor_count")
```
